Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production foreground scenery layer for a 2D side-scrolling endless runner, exact 1792x1024 wide canvas. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: same premium painted pixel art, cinematic neon lighting and high craftsmanship, but outdoors in Rio, no gym.
Primary request: a lively nighttime Rio waterfront CAR MEET among friends, cars parked on the far side of a level road running perfectly horizontally across the image.
COMPOSITION FOR LAYERING: the top 38% is completely EMPTY vivid #00FF00 chroma green. Every open background space ABOVE the asphalt and BETWEEN objects is that same solid green, no skyline, mountains or sky. All scene artwork occupies y=38% through y=82%; the bottom 18% is uninterrupted dark subtly textured asphalt extending edge to edge, no objects in that road strip. All feet and tires touch the same level distant sidewalk at y=80%. Camera side-on, no road vanishing point.
Set dressing: 5 varied parked modified cars spread across the width: a prominent BLACK 1970 DODGE CHARGER R/T with exposed chrome supercharger through the hood, rectangular grille and classic muscle car silhouette on the LEFT third; turquoise coupe, amber coupe, burgundy sports coupe, dark silver car toward the right. Cars in readable side/three-quarter SIDE views, not facing the camera. They are background parked props, car roofs near y=69% and tires at y=80%, not giant cars filling the canvas.
Around and behind cars 15-20 small adult friends chatting in clusters, a couple seated on a hood, one modest table and barbecue grill. Friendly FAMILY reunion feel, casual night streetwear, diverse adults, NO dancing clones, NO main bald muscular running hero. Keep figures smaller than foreground game hero: heads y=64-68%, feet y=80%. Two palms at outer thirds, a few warm string lights and colorful painted low kiosks behind the crowd. A compact open-air bar near x=57% with one clearly legible illuminated sign: "CORONA" large ivory lettering, "EXTRA" smaller below, a bright warm GOLD RIGHT ARROW beside it. Sign at y=48-58%. A smaller right-pointing gold arrow at far right, no extra words. No wall closing the skyline view.
Color: navy and teal dark surfaces, magenta light on car edges, amber street lights, warm skin tones. Road foreground much darker/calmer than cars so the existing white-shirt player stays readable. Pixel-painted craftsmanship, not glossy 3D, not photography, not vector. No traffic motion, no gameplay obstacles, no screenshot HUD, no watermark. Green is exclusively the removable background; no green clothing, plants are dark teal, no green spill. Preserve clean scene silhouettes for chroma extraction.
